{
  "outcome": "REJECT_OR_ESCALATE",
  "request": {
    "id": "DR-9112",
    "customer": "Acme Manufacturing (CRM-2048); ERP: C-1001 (Acme Mfg. Holdings)",
    "product": "NS-500 Industrial Controller",
    "requested_discount": "18.0%",
    "date": "2026-09-23",
    "requestor": "michael.torres@northstar.example",
    "basis": "contract_exception"
  },
  "commercial_eligibility": {
    "status": "exceeded",
    "maximum_discount": "15%",
    "basis": "EXC-ACME-NS500-15 (Schedule B to ACME-MFG-2025), effective 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31"
  },
  "authority": {
    "policy": "Northstar Pricing Policy 2026",
    "requestor_limit": "20%",
    "requestor_authorized": true,
    "required_role": "VP Sales",
    "approver": "Michael Torres"
  },
  "evidence": [
    "ACME-MFG-2025 Section 3.2: Customer eligible for discounts up to 15% on NS-500, effective 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31",
    "EXC-ACME-NS500-15 (Schedule B to ACME-MFG-2025): Maximum eligible discount 15% on NS-500, effective 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31",
    "Northstar Pricing Policy 2026 Section 3: VP Sales may approve discounts >10% and ≤20%",
    "organization_chart.md: Michael Torres is VP Sales, reporting to Chief Revenue Officer",
    "discount_requests.csv: DR-9112 records 18.0% discount requested on 2026-09-23",
    "discount_requests.csv: DR-8104 (2025-09-16): Prior approval for 15% NS-500 discount for same customer and product"
  ],
  "missing_evidence": [],
  "conditions": [
    {
      "what": "CRM record (DR-9112) shows 18% discount requested, but email MSG-20260923-0914 from Sarah Chen refers to 15%. Verify intended discount amount with requestor.",
      "who": "michael.torres@northstar.example",
      "blocking": false
    }
  ]
}
```

---

## Summary

Michael Torres **cannot approve** this request as recorded.

The 18% discount **exceeds the customer's established eligibility** under the active pricing exception EXC-ACME-NS500-15 (Schedule B to their Master Supply Agreement), which caps NS-500 discounts at 15%. Although Michael Torres holds VP Sales authority to approve discounts up to 20% under the 2026 Pricing Policy, his approval authority does not override the customer's contractual maximum. 

This requires **escalation to obtain new or amended commercial terms**, either an amendment to the pricing exception or renegotiation of the customer's contract, before the 18% discount can be approved. A request for 15% would fall within both the customer's contractual eligibility and the requestor's approval authority.
